segments.text: Is an MBA still worth it in 2026?
India's top business schools are under pressure. IM Ahmedabad and IM Kolkata still top the rankings. But the real
story isn't rank, it's returns. Average salaries at the top 25 B schools have slipped from 23.12 lak rupees to 22.7
lak rupees [music] while average fees have crossed 20 lak rupees. ROI is shrinking quietly. Placements are slower, internships are getting cut, and

global uncertainty combined with AI [music] adoption is making companies cautious about hiring even at top campuses. So, what are the best B schools doing? They're redesigning classrooms. [music] Less road theory,
industry projects, and AIdriven decision-m because in 2026, companies don't hire people with degrees. They hire judgment. They hire problem
solvers. Firms like McKenzie still hire heavily from top B schools. 77% of their India hiring in the last 3 years comes from these campuses. So in an AIdriven
world, is an MBA still relevant or just expensive validation? Let me know in the comments.
